claims.claim: The legacy session migration re-encoded the cwd locally and dropped backslashes, writing migrated files outside the reader's canonical directory.
claims.citation: faulty baseline (HEAD) packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts:111-118: safePath uses /[/:]/g while faulty baseline core/session-manager.ts:592 used /[/\\]/g

claims.claim: The canonical session directory encoding must collapse /, \ and : per the repository's own contract test.
The canonical encoder now handles all three separators and is documented as the single source of truth.
The migration now delegates to the session manager's exported getDefaultSessionDir(cwd, agentDir) instead of duplicating the encoding; no public API changed.

Migrated files are verified through the real session reader (SessionManager.list/open, loadEntriesFromFile) across module boundaries, with byte equality, entry order, Unicode and malformed-line tolerance.
Collisions do not overwrite data and repeated migration is a no-op.
claims.citation: .prale-eval/regression.mjs:175-180 (repeated migration is a no-op) and .prale-eval/regression.mjs:183-216 (collision keeps both files)

validation.notes: Exit 0 on the repaired tree: 5 absolute POSIX path-contract cases (cwd containing '/', '\', ':' and Unicode, including the Windows-style fragment /mnt/c/C:\Users\dev\プロジェクト 😀/repo) plus a name-collision case pass. The script links the real modules via the read-only .prale-eval/subject.mjs (createSessionPipeline); only getAgentDir and fs.readdirSync ordering are faked. Assertions cross module boundaries: getDefaultSessionDir(cwd, agentDir) must equal join(agentDir, 'sessions', '--'+cwd.replace(/^[/\\]/,'').replace(/[/\\:]/g,'-')+'--'); after migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot() the file exists in that directory with byte-identical content (Buffer.compare === 0) and is gone from the agent root; SessionManager.list(cwd) then finds exactly one session with the original header id/cwd, messageCount 2 for a file containing one malformed line, and the Unicode firstMessage intact; loadEntriesFromFile() returns entries in file order (session, message, message, session_info) and SessionManager.open() returns the same id order with Unicode payloads preserved. Two extra migration runs leave a byte-for-byte snapshot of the agent dir unchanged, and a pre-existing colliding target file keeps its exact bytes while the colliding legacy source is preserved. Mutation check: restoring only packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts to its HEAD baseline fails with AssertionError 'session manager lookup must encode slashes, backslashes and colons for cwd "/srv/pi/work:main/app"'; restoring only packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts to its HEAD baseline fails with AssertionError 'migration must place legacy-backslash.jsonl in the canonical session dir for cwd "/srv/pi/work\\legacy\\deep"'. Both are uncaught node:assert/strict failures, not crashes, import errors or timeouts. Temporary fixtures live under .prale-eval/.tmp-session-migration/ and are removed in a finally block. Limitation: no node_modules are installed in the workspace, so npm-based checks (tsgo --noEmit, biome, vitest) were not run and no dependencies were installed; TypeScript syntax validity is still exercised each run because subject.mjs parses both edited modules with node:module.stripTypeScriptTypes.
